# EduVerify India — APAAR Flow Prototype

A beginner-friendly Java Spring Boot web prototype for student registration, typed supporting-document uploads, demo APAAR-style ID generation, student login, and verification-officer review.

See `QUICK_START.md` for Windows/VS Code setup. Extract the ZIP and open the extracted project folder containing `pom.xml`.

The project uses an in-memory H2 database with an explicit Hibernate dialect to avoid needing a separate database server.

**Scope note:** IDs generated by this project are local demo identifiers, not official APAAR IDs. No government database is accessed. Use fictional student data only.

## Verification officer demo login

Default demo credentials (for presentation only):
- Email: `officer@eduverify.demo`
- Password: `OfficerDemo2026!`

Before sharing the public demo, set Render environment variables `OFFICER_EMAIL` and `OFFICER_PASSWORD` to your own demo credentials. This is a learning prototype, not production-grade authentication. Student passwords are also stored in plain text in this prototype; use fictional data only and do not use it for real student records.

## Supporting document categories

New students register first and receive a generated demo APAAR ID. They then sign in through Student Login and upload Birth Certificate, Aadhaar Card / Aadhaar Proof, Address Proof, and Identity Proof from their student dashboard. Returning students can log in directly with their demo APAAR ID and password. The Officer Login leads to the protected review dashboard. The demo accepts up to five files total, 5 MB per file. Use fictional/sample files only; never upload real Aadhaar or sensitive certificates.
